recap.text: Katia's card fight against Ysalte and Amayon erupts all at once, and she summons her scary-ass bird creature, then plays a consumable utility card called Timeless to keep it summoned forever. Annie – Útburður lands on her shoulder in a fanfare of burning embers and dancing baby pacifiers: a cat-sized raven with a human infant's skull for a head, its little holes filled with teeth. It is Level 80, and Katia leans in and whispers instructions to it.

Katia's totem card, Annie, is a crow with the skull of an infant, and Carl first sees it on her shoulder in a dream, where it rubs its small head against hers while she tells him a little girl died with nobody to call her own. Days after that dream, Annie comes out covered in blood in Club Vanquisher and vanishes in a puff of smoke. Katia leaves the card on a table, and Donut takes it.

beats.headline: A raven with an infant's skull
beats.text: The card fight against Ysalte and Amayon erupts all at once. Katia summons her scary-ass bird creature, then a consumable utility card called Timeless, which will keep it summoned forever. It lands on her shoulder in a fanfare of colourful, burning embers and dancing baby pacifiers: a large raven, cat-sized, whose head is the skull of a human infant, the little holes in it filled with teeth. Annie – Útburður. Level 80. Katia leans in and whispers instructions to it.
beats.gist: Katia summons Útburður, a cat-sized raven with an infant's skull for a head, and Timeless.

beats.headline: On Katia's shoulder, in the dream
beats.text: At a field ruling adjudication, the dream Carl and Katia shared plays on a floating screen. There is the memory of Katia pleading with a faceless woman, who answers with Annie's medical needs, and sweeping everything off the woman's desk. And there is the Katia who watched it with Carl and cried on his shoulder. That Katia had a crow on her own shoulder, the card she brought from the floor before: a crow with the skull of an infant. The crow's name is also Annie. Carl does not know what that means, but it seems important.
beats.gist: Katia's dream plays on a screen, and her crow, a card bearing an infant's skull, shares Annie's name.

beats.headline: Out, and covered in blood
beats.text: Inside Club Vanquisher, Carl stiff-legs around a corner as Katia, Prepotente, Li Jun and Zhang round the far end of the hall. Bianca is out and roaring. So is Annie, Katia's totem. The skull-headed bird is covered in blood, and it disappears in a puff of smoke. A sap-like substance drips from the ceiling, the walls shake, and Prepotente presses a wall panel to open the hidden door they all rush through.
beats.gist: Katia's totem Annie, covered in blood, vanishes in smoke as Carl's group rushes through a hidden door.

beats.headline: A comfort in the dream
beats.text: Several days earlier: Carl lands in Katia's dream, not the one from Shi Maria's point of view he was meant to have. No, she says, not this. A bird appears on her shoulder, a bird with the skull of a child, and it rubs its small, ghoulish head against hers in comfort. This is her card from the floor before, and its name is Annie. When Katia tells him how the little girl died with nobody to call her own, she reaches up and strokes the other Annie, the bird. She was like me in that way, she says. All alone.
beats.gist: Carl lands in Katia's dream, where Annie, her child-skulled bird card, comforts her.

beats.headline: Left on the table
beats.text: Emberus is three minutes from destroying the floor, and Katia is gone. On the table she left a pair of items. One is her card from the floor before, the one depicting Annie the skull-headed bird. Donut takes it. The other is a bra with Carl's face on one cup and Time to pay the daddy tax on the other, and Elle grabs that. Carl assumes it came from the Dungeon Sidekicks show and was left as a joke.
beats.gist: Donut takes Katia's Annie card, and Elle grabs a bra bearing Carl's face.

relations.note: taken from the table Katia left it on
